name: Akfen Insaat Turizm ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
summary: Akfen Insaat Turizm ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages in the construction business in Turkey. The company constructs hospitals, dormitories, and housing, as well as residential and commercial properties. It also undertakes contracting works for infrastructure facilities, such as roads, bridges, dams, and ports, as well as industrial and touristic facilities, hotels, airport terminals and runways, and hydroelectric power plants. In addition, it operates city hospitals built and operated under the public-private partnership models.
